text: Cycling requires a commitment to safety and proper equipment to minimize the risk of accidents. Among the essential safety gear, a helmet is a fundamental component to protect the head from severe head impacts. It is recommended to wear a high-quality bicycle helmet that fits snugly and is certified to meet safety standards such as the ASTM F135 standard. Alongside the helmet, cycling gloves or grips, and cycling shorts or leggings provide additional cushioning and support during long rides or sudden obstacles. Furthermore, cycling gear includes jerseys, shorts, and socks that are designed to provide optimal aerodynamics and warmth while riding. Chainmail gloves offer extra protection for the hands, while padded shorts or pedals offer ankle and knee protection. Maintaining a proper gear ratio is also crucial to efficient cycling, as it influences both speed and comfort, making it essential for cyclists to choose the right gears for their preferred terrain and riding style.
